column2: (1) The general objects for which the Corporation is

column1: established are hereby declared to be—

column2: establish  vocational  training  centres  and  conduct
other training programmes for the unemployed and
needy  with  a  view  to  prepare  them  for  a  better
livelihood  through  self  employment  and  thereby
to uplift the econmic standards of the people which
alleviates poverty of the people in Sri Lanka;
promote the advancement of health of the people
in remote and under developed areas by providing
assistance  financially  or  otherwise  for  the
establishment  of  healthcare  centres  and  hospitals
and to provide equipment, medicine, wheel chairs
and other provisions to hospitals and health centres
for distribution to the patients;
organize  programmes  which  may  encourage
religious and ethnic harmony;
conduct  seminars,  workshops  and  similar

programmes  which  may  contribute 
to 
the
development  of  personality  of  youth  and  thereby
to build up a refined society;
assist people affected by any man made or natural
disasters by constructing houses and roads for them
and assisting such persons to resume their normal
day to day livelihood;
assist needy and deserving students to further their
education  by  conducting  classes,  by  providing
books,  equipment  and  school  uniforms  to  such
students and to assist them financially or otherwise
to complete thier education;
enter into ageements with other institutions which
have similar objects as the Corporation and thereby
facilitate  the  exchange  of  resources  among  such
institutions;
